name: Get Sales Persons
summary: Fetches sales person records by their external ID (usually their email), Marketo ID, or email.
whenToUse: When you want to look up a rep's Marketo ID (externalSalesPersonId is often their email) or their synced profile data.

query.name: filterType
query.label: Look up by
query.hint: Which field the values below match on.

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Optional comma-separated field API names. If omitted, all populated fields come back.

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Next page token
query.hint: Optional. Copy nextPageToken from the previous response to continue.

response.description: Sales person records (id, externalSalesPersonId, email, name fields, dates).

notes: Requires SFDC or Dynamics Sync on the instance — sales person records come from the CRM.
